english: The marks of the students of section $A$ form the following continuous frequency distribution, in which each class contains its left end point but not its right end point, and $f$ is a positive integer.

Section $B$ has $25$ students whose mean mark is $52$. The arithmetic mean of the marks of all the students of the two sections taken together, computed with the class marks for section $A$, is $48$. Then the number of students of section $A$ who scored at least $40$ marks is ______.
hindi: अनुभाग $A$ के विद्यार्थियों के अंक निम्न सतत बारंबारता बंटन बनाते हैं, जिसमें प्रत्येक वर्ग में उसका बायाँ अन्त्य बिन्दु सम्मिलित है परन्तु दायाँ अन्त्य बिन्दु नहीं, तथा $f$ एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक है।

अनुभाग $B$ में $25$ विद्यार्थी हैं जिनके अंकों का माध्य $52$ है। दोनों अनुभागों के सभी विद्यार्थियों के अंकों का समान्तर माध्य, अनुभाग $A$ के लिए वर्ग चिह्नों से परिकलित, $48$ है। तब अनुभाग $A$ के उन विद्यार्थियों की संख्या जिन्होंने कम से कम $40$ अंक प्राप्त किए, ______ है।
solution_full: Class marks of section $A$: $10,30,50,70$. Total of section $A$: $30+210+50f+350=590+50f$, with $15+f$ students.
Check: section $A$ has $30$ students with mean $\dfrac{1340}{30}$; $\dfrac{1340+1300}{55}=48$.
Students of $A$ with at least $40$ marks are those in $[40,60)$ and $[60,80)$: $15+5=20$.
originality_note: New: an unknown class frequency of one section is fixed through the combined mean with a second, ungrouped section, and the question asks for a count read from the completed table (way 5: grouped mean inside a combined mean). Closest known: missing frequency from a given mean. Different because: the given mean is the combined one, so the second section's total enters the equation.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. The asked count (20) avoids a bare 'value of f'. Changed: No change.
key_step: Writing the combined mean with the grouped total of A and solving the linear equation for f.
justification: A routine two-step chain (grouped total, combined mean). Comparable to 2025-P1-Q14 (L2).

concept_use.Arithmetic mean of a continuous frequenc: Section A's total 590 + 50f from the class marks.
concept_use.Combined mean of two or more series: (Total A + Total B)/(n_A + n_B) = 48 gives f = 15.
